verdict.rationale: Pendo's first-party Data Sync product exports Pendo data directly to Snowflake with no engineering, and can also export to cloud storage (S3, Azure, Google Cloud). This covers the story's export-to-warehouse branch. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that exports are continuous or scheduled and event-level (the claims say only 'data'/'insights'), schema or setup depth, any in-product querying of warehouse tables, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
